scope: Factual evidence only; not a probability, investment assessment, or position recommendation. Frozen rule and identity remain in prior facts file.

identity.question: Will the Bank of Korea hold at the October 2026 meeting?

findings.claim: Official 2026 meeting-date notice and attached PDF both identify October 22 (Thursday) as an MPB policy-setting meeting. Page dated 2025-10-30; attachment downloaded with HTTP 200.

The BOK policy-decision list captured now displays Aug 27, 2026 as its latest listed 2026 decision, followed by Jul 16, May 28 and Apr 10; no later October decision appears in this list. Aug 27 opening decision says base rate raised 25 bp from 2.75% to 3.00%.
September 2026 CPI: headline index 120.43 (2020=100), +0.3% m/m and +2.9% y/y; CPI excluding food and energy 116.53, -0.1% m/m and +2.8% y/y. Release page title is September CPI; body states values.

BOK Q2 household credits release dated 2026-08-19: total outstanding +KRW25.9tn q/q to KRW2,019.8tn end-June; household loans KRW1,891.3tn; merchandise credits KRW128.5tn. BOK statistical calendar schedules Q3 household credit for Nov 18, after the meeting.

BOK statistical calendar lists Q2 real GDP advance estimate released Jul 23 and Q3 advance estimate scheduled Oct 27 (after the Oct 22 meeting). Thus no Q3 GDP release was scheduled before the meeting.

CNA article credited to Reuters, published Oct 20, reports Reuters survey fielded Oct 14–19: all 34 economists expected a 3.00% hold on Oct 22. CNA is a syndication, not the Reuters-hosted primary page; no direct Reuters URL/body was verified in this pass.

gaps: Official Q2 GDP body/value not captured; BOK calendar verifies Q2 release Jul 23 and Q3 release Oct 27.
Poll body is CNA syndication credited to Reuters; direct Reuters-hosted URL/body not verified.
Latest-decision conclusion is limited to the BOK list as captured.
